body: The 3 certainties in life 😂🔥 Baby Keem @babykeem and Kendrick Lamar @kendricklamar’s “family ties” has officially been certified 6× Platinum in the United States, representing over 6 million units sold 🔥📈 Released in 2021, the collaboration debuted and peaked at No. 18 on the Billboard Hot 100, remained on the chart for 19 weeks and later won Best Rap Performance at the 2022 Grammy Awards—giving Keem the first Grammy win of his career 🏆 Nearly five years later, “family ties” continues to prove it’s one of the biggest and most successful rap collaborations of the decade. How has this song aged? 👀

The 3 certainties in life 😂🔥

Baby Keem and Kendrick Lamar’s “family ties” has officially been certified 6× Platinum in the United States, representing over 6 million units sold 🔥📈

Released in 2021, the collaboration debuted and peaked at No. 18 on the Billboard Hot 100, remained on the chart for 19 weeks and later won Best Rap Performance at the 2022 Grammy Awards—giving Keem the first Grammy win of his career 🏆

Nearly five years later, “family ties” continues to prove it’s one of the biggest and most successful rap collaborations of the decade. How has this song aged? 👀
